test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly visited archive URLs of the form http://localhost:8000/?m=202512&paged=X. The first visited paged value was 2 (start_paged). The agent progressed up to paged=10 (used here as older_target_paged) and then navigated back to paged=9 (newer_target_paged). The base_url and m are taken directly from those URLs.
